KAFKA-VEILED_SHARDS.title: Veiled Shards
KAFKA-VEILED_SHARDS.description:
At the start of combat, apply [gold]Shock[/gold](2 damage, 1 turn) to ALL enemies.
Every 4 [gold]Pursuit[/gold] triggers, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
Every 2 [gold]Detonations[/gold], draw 1 card.
KAFKA-VEILED_SHARDS.flavor: A sealed stellaron fragment, purple lightning flickering restlessly through its cracks.
KAFKA-SUNDERED_BONDS.title: Sundered Bonds
KAFKA-SUNDERED_BONDS.description:
At the start of combat, apply [gold]Shock[/gold](7 damage, 2 turns) to ALL enemies.
Every 3 [gold]Pursuit[/gold] triggers, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
Every 2 [gold]Detonations[/gold], draw 1 card.
KAFKA-SUNDERED_BONDS.flavor: The chains shattered, the stellaron's power fully awakened, thunder roaring within.
KAFKA-WHISPER_OF_WHISPERS.title: Whisper of Whispers
KAFKA-WHISPER_OF_WHISPERS.description: The first card [gold]Rewritten[/gold] each turn costs {energyPrefix:energyIcons(0)} this turn.
KAFKA-WHISPER_OF_WHISPERS.flavor: Turn the page, and whispers of fate echo in your ears.
KAFKA-DESTINYS_CALL.title: Destiny's Call
KAFKA-DESTINYS_CALL.flavor: The cards have been dealt. Fate is yours to write.
KAFKA-MANIPULATORS_TOUCH.title: Manipulator's Touch
KAFKA-MANIPULATORS_TOUCH.description: [gold]Shock[/gold] applied by your Power card effects deals +2 damage.
KAFKA-MANIPULATORS_TOUCH.flavor: Claws trace through the void, the will to manipulate never rests.
KAFKA-CROWSONGS_TOLL.title: Crowsong's Toll
KAFKA-CROWSONGS_TOLL.description: At the start of your turn, apply [gold]Shock[/gold](3 damage, 2 turns) to a random enemy.
KAFKA-CROWSONGS_TOLL.flavor: A black feather falls, and the curse descends in silence.
KAFKA-WEB_OF_INTRIGUE.title: Web of Intrigue
KAFKA-WEB_OF_INTRIGUE.description: When a [gold]Pursuit[/gold] card does NOT trigger Pursuit, draw 1 card.
KAFKA-WEB_OF_INTRIGUE.flavor: The intelligence network is everywhere. Every miss is a new lead.
KAFKA-SERPENTS_ELIXIR.title: Serpent's Elixir
KAFKA-SERPENTS_ELIXIR.description: Each [gold]Detonation[/gold] has a 15% chance to trigger again.
KAFKA-SERPENTS_ELIXIR.flavor: An unstable purple liquid. Chain reactions may occur at any moment.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E1_KAFKA.title: E1·Perpetual Motion! Perpetual
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E1_KAFKA.description: At combat start, apply [gold]Shock[/gold](4 damage, 2 turns) to ALL enemies.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E1_KAFKA.flavor: Dance steps in the darkness, never ceasing.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E2_KAFKA.title: E2·Rhapsodist, Sob
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E2_KAFKA.description: Whenever you [gold]Rewrite[/gold] a card, 30% chance the rewritten card costs 0 this turn.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E2_KAFKA.flavor: She begins with a sob and pens her rhapsody.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E3_KAFKA.title: E3·I Praise, Improvise
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E3_KAFKA.description: Whenever a [gold]Shock[/gold] deals damage at turn start, 50% chance to gain 1 Block.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E3_KAFKA.flavor: Improvisation — the freest line in fate's score.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E4_KAFKA.title: E4·Dedicated to the Recitative
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E4_KAFKA.description: The first time you trigger [gold]Pursuit[/gold] each turn, that [gold]Pursuit[/gold] triggers 1 additional time.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E4_KAFKA.flavor: Every soliloquy is dedicated to a silent audience.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E5_KAFKA.title: E5·Tonight Resounds Alone
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E5_KAFKA.description: Whenever you apply [gold]Shock[/gold], it gains +2 damage and +1 turn duration.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E5_KAFKA.flavor: The finale hasn't fallen; only tonight may resound.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E6_KAFKA.title: E6·Rondo, Softly
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E6_KAFKA.description: Whenever a [gold]Shock[/gold] deals damage at turn start, 10% chance to [gold]Detonate[/gold] that target.
KAFKA-EIDOLON_E6_KAFKA.flavor: The melody returns to its start — none hear the thunder coming.
